page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s2 server family. Built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 2 dedicated virtual CPUs and 8.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 4.0 GB per core, aligning with standard general-purpose resource distributions. The instance does not include local storage or integrated graphics processing units, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system deployment and data persistence.

The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing predictable execution times for baseline workloads. Because there are no local NVMe or SSD drives bundled with the hardware, storage performance is entirely dependent on the attached network storage infrastructure. The instance is suitable for low-to-medium traffic web servers, small databases, development environments, and basic containerized applications that do not require specialized hardware acceleration or high-performance local disk I/O.
